title: AWS SageMaker SFT — Conversational (messages) Format
description: Export schema for SageMaker serverless model customization SFT jobs using the Conversational format. One JSON object per line in a .jsonl file. Each object contains a messages array with role/content pairs.

role.description: The role of the message sender

_constraints.message_order: system (optional, first) -> user -> assistant (must alternate, end with assistant)
_constraints.min_messages: At least one user message and one assistant message required
_constraints.system_position: If present, system message must be the first message

messages.content: How do I reset my password?
To reset your password, go to Settings > Security > Change Password.
You are a helpful bilingual assistant for Malaysian users.
Boleh explain pasal data plan yang murah?
Plan paling murah kami ialah Plan Asas RM29/bulan dengan 8GB data dan unlimited calls.
